requirements.quote: In `packages/drafting`: `blocks.ts`, `slots.ts` (pure resolvers over supplied facts returning {value, provenance} for case number, court, bench, parties, next date, counsel; unresolved renders `[[missing: <slot>]]` and blocks export unless acknowledged)
`presets/madras-hc.ts` and `karnataka-hc.ts` as data (A4, Times New Roman 14pt, 1.5 spacing, 20 MB cap for Madras)
`render/docx.ts` (docx lib, custom property `AI-assisted` true only when a model-drafted narrative block is unrewritten)
`render/pdf.ts` (pdf-lib + fontkit, embedded fonts incl. Noto Sans Tamil/Kannada, searchable text, typed error above 20 MB)
`narrative.ts` (calls the ai gateway through an injected port, schema-validated output, no tools, India-only default) and a `draft_narrative` task in `packages/ai/src/tasks`.
Static test: package exposes no send/file/submit function.
Update `packages/drafting/package.json` (docx, pdf-lib, @pdf-lib/fontkit, fflate dev, @causedeck/validators, @causedeck/ai; reasons: render and schema validation).
Coverage >= 90% lines for presets and slots; golden DOCX styles XML snapshot; no `any` in exports.

deliverables.change: Add dependencies: docx, pdf-lib, @pdf-lib/fontkit (render: DOCX/PDF output, catalog versions), @causedeck/validators (schema validation of block trees and presets; subpath ./drafting), @causedeck/ai (draft_narrative task input/output types and gateway port types); devDependencies: fflate (unzip DOCX in the golden styles.xml test), @fontsource/noto-sans-tamil, @fontsource/noto-sans-kannada, regenerator-runtime (fontkit needs it; same as packages/intelligence/package.json). All 'catalog:' except workspace:*. Update pnpm-lock.yaml via pnpm install --offline --lockfile-only if possible.
Lockfile importer entry for packages/drafting reflecting D1 (no new catalog versions).

Add 'karnataka_hc' to COURT_PRESETS and 'hearing.bench' to SLOT_RESOLVERS (and any counsel resolver needed; keep advocate.name as counsel); update packages/validators/src/drafting.test.ts expectations.
Block tree helpers over validators Block: walk, validate via BlockTreeSchema, collect slots/narratives, block ids.
Pure resolveSlot/resolveBlocks over a supplied Facts object returning {value, provenance}; unresolved gives '[[missing: <resolver>]]'; exportBlockers(...) lists unresolved slots unless acknowledged.
Madras HC FormatPreset data (A4, Times New Roman 14pt, 1.5 spacing) plus maxExportBytes 20 MB; validated with FormatPresetSchema.
Karnataka HC FormatPreset data (A4, Times New Roman 14pt, 1.5 spacing); presets/index.ts exports a lookup by key.
Barrel + getPreset(key) over the two presets.
renderDocx(blocks, preset, facts, opts) -> Uint8Array using docx; custom property 'AI-assisted' true only when a model-drafted narrative block is unrewritten; styles from preset.

renderPdf(...) using pdf-lib + fontkit, embed Noto Sans Tamil/Kannada (resolve woff via createRequire like packages/intelligence/src/synthetic/make-docs.ts:10-18, import regenerator-runtime first) and a Latin-capable face so text is searchable; throw typed PdfTooLargeError when bytes exceed preset cap (20 MB Madras).

draftNarrative(port, block, facts, ctx): port is an injected interface {run(taskId,input,ctx)}; calls 'draft_narrative', validates output with the task output schema and block maxChars; no tools; passes india-only default through context (indiaOnly true unless caller overrides).
Re-export public API; keep packageName; no send/file/submit export; no `any`.
New TaskDef id 'draft_narrative', zod input {prompt, facts, maxChars, locale} / output {text}, providers ['bedrock'], tier 'drafting', promptId 'draft_narrative.v1', defaultLevel 2.
Import and register draft_narrative in TASKS.
Task test: promptId, tier drafting, bedrock-only, schema accept/reject.

Tests for blocks, slots (>=90% lines), presets, docx (golden styles.xml snapshot via fflate, AI-assisted property both ways), pdf (Tamil/Kannada text, 20 MB typed error via injected cap), narrative (fake port, invalid output rejected), static API test (no export name matches /send|file|submit/i, source has no `: any`/`as any`). May be split into several test files; update packages/drafting/src/index.test.ts as needed.
Add coverage thresholds (lines 90) scoped to src/slots.ts and src/presets/**.

preserve.what: All existing task ids, schemas and the 'every task has a schema-valid mock output / promptId contains id' guard in packages/ai/src/__tests__/policy.test.ts

Validators contracts consumed by packages/db and core (BlockSchema, TemplateSchema, DraftSchema, ExportRequestSchema, existing COURT_PRESETS/SLOT_RESOLVERS members) in packages/validators/src/drafting.ts; changes are additive only
@causedeck/drafting stays importable by apps/web (apps/web/package.json:56) with packageName export unchanged
No new core runtime export: do not touch packages/core, so the cross-tenant registry needs no change

validate.command: pnpm --filter @causedeck/ai exec vitest run src/tasks src/__tests__/policy.test.ts src/providers/providers.test.ts --maxWorkers=${FORGE_HOST_PARALLELISM:-2}

decisions.justification: Named in the issue; drafting is a leaf consumed by core (docs/engineering/13-technical-architecture-spike.md:94); packages/intelligence already depends on both (packages/intelligence/package.json). Reasons: schema validation (validators) and the draft_narrative task types (ai).

decisions.choice: Embed Tamil/Kannada fonts from @fontsource via createRequire and import regenerator-runtime before fontkit
decisions.justification: packages/intelligence/src/synthetic/make-docs.ts:10-18 does exactly this; the packages are in pnpm-workspace.yaml:60-61.

decisions.choice: Extend validators' closed lists (karnataka_hc, hearing.bench) rather than keeping presets outside the schema
decisions.justification: FormatPresetSchema.key is z.enum(COURT_PRESETS) (packages/validators/src/drafting.ts:38,~150), so a Karnataka preset would otherwise fail validation; changes are additive.

decisions.choice: Narrative uses an injected port typed locally, not a hard import of createGateway
decisions.justification: Issue says 'through an injected port'; keeps the engine pure and testable. AiGateway.run signature is packages/ai/src/gateway.ts:38.
